editDialog.audienceNote: 👥 The audience is edited via “Re-notify” (the selection is editable before sending).

editDialog.capacityBelowConfirmed_other: Can't reduce to {{capacity}} spots: {{confirmed}} people are already confirmed. Remove a confirmed volunteer first.

deleteDraft.title: Delete this draft?
deleteDraft.description: The draft will be permanently deleted. Nobody will be notified.

closeDialog2.title: Close this need?
closeDialog2.description_one: No more volunteers needed (spot filled otherwise). Applications stop; the {{confirmed}} confirmed volunteer is still expected and keeps their reminder.
closeDialog2.description_other: No more volunteers needed (spot filled otherwise). The {{confirmed}} confirmed volunteers are still expected and keep their reminders.
closeDialog2.descriptionEmpty: No more volunteers needed (spot filled otherwise). Applications stop.

cancelDialog2.title: Cancel this need?
cancelDialog2.descriptionMany: This need won't happen. {{confirmed}} confirmed and {{pending}} pending applicants will be notified they're no longer expected.
cancelDialog2.descriptionOnlyConfirmed_one: This need won't happen. {{confirmed}} confirmed person will be notified they're no longer expected.
cancelDialog2.descriptionOnlyConfirmed_other: This need won't happen. {{confirmed}} confirmed people will be notified they're no longer expected.
cancelDialog2.descriptionOnlyPending_one: This need won't happen. {{pending}} pending applicant will be notified.
cancelDialog2.descriptionOnlyPending_other: This need won't happen. {{pending}} pending applicants will be notified.
cancelDialog2.descriptionNone: This need won't happen. Nobody applied, so no notification will be sent.
